name: fill_padded_rows
description: fill_padded_rows(x, num_token_non_padded, fill_value) -> out. x has shape [R, C] and num_token_non_padded is a device scalar or Python integer n giving the number of valid rows. Return a newly allocated copy of x in which rows n through R-1 are set to fill_value cast to x.dtype; rows before n are copied unchanged. If n >= R, no row is changed. The native implementation reads n on device and uses a flat contiguous path when possible, or a row-strided 2D path for non-contiguous row layouts. No input mutation. The exercised dtypes include int32, float32, and bfloat16, with fill_value -1 or 0.0.
